text: shift / ctrl + click on computer, long tap on touch/android for selecting multiple aims in list view
description: Multi-selection gestures specifically in the recursive list/column view: desktop modifier-click and mobile long-press, using shared selection state.
reflection: List long-press now toggles shared multi-selection before opening the action menu. Focused Aim and list-store tests pass (9/9); frontend production build passes.

status.comment: Desktop modifier/range selection and list-view touch long-press are implemented; awaiting user acceptance.
